comment: D1 muon/hadron arms, gun samples (synthetic single particles; nothing collaboration-internal). Read by make_guns.py. One HEPEVT chunk per job, flat index 0..79; per species the first half of its chunks is train, the second half test. Declared 2026-11-22 before any stock or detsim output of these samples existed.
direction: cos(theta) to +z uniform in [0.2, 1.0], phi uniform
time_comment: uniform over the span of the electron replay times, so the readout window treats both alike
energy: kinetic energy log-uniform per species, GeV
charge_split: for two pdg codes, each event draws one with probability 1/2
